items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that you had arranged some songs for Charlie Ventura, for Artie Shaw, for Claude Thornhill.

ctx.x: Well, the master may not be able to convey anything to you about it.

I think you’ll elucidate a lot for us. I read somewhere – I don’t remember what the source was – that you had arranged some songs for Charlie Ventura, for Artie Shaw, for Claude Thornhill. I remember thinking at one point – and please correctly me if I’m wrong, and I probably am – I remember thinking at one point, oh those were probably just paying gigs. But then, Claude Thornhill made some interesting music.
